interchanges.reason: IF 83-293-01, REFER TO 4305901210: THE APPROVED WHEELS FITTED WITH THE CRANE PRESSURE SENSOR HOLDER ARE INTERCHANGEABLE WITH APPROVED WHEELS FITTED WITH THE SAFRAN PRESSURE SENSOR HOLDER. TO FIT A SAFRAN PSH EQUIPPED WHEEL TO A CRANE TPIS EQUIPPED AIRCRAFT, THE CRANE PS AND RIU MUST BE REMOVED (TO BE ADDED TO CDL) AND A SAFRAN SEAL CAP FITTED (P/N 4133811350, REFER TO H17265). THEREFORE THE PSH IS ICY 352. MMEL 32-07-07 & 32-09-01A SHALL BE FOLLOWED FOR THE AFFECTED WHEEL POSITION.
